title: New Wave 26 at MPRG
summary: MPRG's contemporary survey showcasing a new generation of Australian art practice. Free, Tue to Sun 11am to 4pm, running to 31 May.
suggestedItineraryPairing: Gallery, lunch on Main Street, pair with TRACE exhibition
editorVerdict: New Wave 26 is MPRG doing what MPRG does best: a tightly curated contemporary survey that punches well above the building it's in.
editorNote:
An ensemble survey of where Australian contemporary practice sits right now, hung in MPRG's main rooms alongside the Michael Vale solo show. The two together justify a Saturday morning if the weather is doubtful or if you've been meaning to use the gallery and never have.

The show closes 31 May. Free entry, no booking, Tue to Sun 11am to 4pm. Plan ninety minutes for the show and another forty for the family activity space if you've brought kids.

Pair with lunch on Main Street and, if your timing is good, drop into TRACE at Lander-Se on the same loop.
kidsGradeNote: School-age and up handle this fine, especially with the activity space; under-fives will burn out in ten minutes.
